Brad has provided the free/busy information for Elena and David, and has tasked me with finding the 3-person meeting slots for (Priya, Marcus, and Elena) and (Priya, Marcus, and David).

First, I need to find the common availability for Priya and Marcus. I've done this before, but it's good to double check.
Priya & Marcus common free slots:
- Mon: 09:00, 09:30
- Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
- Wed: 15:00, 15:30
- Thu: 10:00
- Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Next, I'll check these common slots against Elena's and David's free times.

For (Priya, Marcus, and Elena):
- Mon 09:00 & 09:30: Elena is busy.
- Tue 13:00 & 13:30 & 16:30: Elena is busy.
- Wed 15:00: Elena is free. This is a match. David is busy at this time.
- Wed 15:30: Elena is busy.
- Thu 10:00: Elena is busy.
- Fri 11:00 & 11:30: Elena is busy.
So, the only slot for (Priya, Marcus, Elena) is Wednesday at 15:00.

For (Priya, Marcus, and David):
- Mon 09:00 & 09:30: David is busy.
- Tue 13:00 & 13:30 & 16:30: David is busy.
- Wed 15:00 & 15:30: David is busy.
- Thu 10:00: David is free. This is a match. Elena is busy at this time.
- Fri 11:00 & 11:30: David is busy.
So, the only slot for (Priya, Marcus, David) is Thursday at 10:00.

So, I have found two 3-person slots:
-   Wednesday 15:00 (Priya, Marcus, Elena are free; David is busy)
-   Thursday 10:00 (Priya, Marcus, David are free; Elena is busy)

Brad found:
-   Thursday 14:30 (Elena, David, Priya are free; Marcus is busy)
-   Monday 11:00 (Elena, David, Marcus are free; Priya is busy)

Now I have a complete list of four potential meeting times, each with one person who is not available.
- Mon 11:00 (Priya busy with "Travel")
- Wed 15:00 (David busy)
- Thu 10:00 (Elena busy)
- Thu 14:30 (Marcus busy with "Dentist appointment")

The best path forward is to choose one of these slots and book it. The busy partner might be able to reschedule their conflicting appointment. I will suggest we book Thursday at 10:00, as I don't have information about how critical Elena's conflict is. I will communicate my findings and suggestion to Brad.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
